paragraphs: Pano AI sells a wildfire management product built to detect threats early, notify parties of confirmed incidents, and deliver visual intelligence and real-time data. The stated purpose is faster, collaborative wildfire response that helps keep communities, property, and the environment safe.

For utilities, the pitch is early detection and intelligence that helps maintain a reliable power supply and protect infrastructure amid increasing wildfire risks. For fire professionals, it aims to equip emergency managers and first responders to optimize response efforts, improve coordination, and protect firefighter safety. For landowners, it is framed as helping first responders coordinate an informed, rapid response before a fire escalates. The contact form offers first responders access to existing Pano Stations.

The team is described as technology and business experts with experience in data management, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deploying technology into organizations of all sizes. The company says it supports professionals in the utility and fire industries who work to protect lives, property, and livelihoods from wildfires. A testimonial on the site states that over the last three years 95% of fires were kept below 10 acres.

quote.text: Enable faster, collaborative wildfire response efforts to help keep communities, property, and the environment safe.
